title: Fish 'N Chips
description: Fish and Chips, the animated series tells the stories of two antagonistic characters, young impressionable "Fish" and his mischievous, lifelong enemy "chips" as they tear across both land and sea in these exciting adventures that are sure to have both children and adults laughing.

title: Lock 'n' Load
description: On the heels of the U.S. Supreme Court's recent ruling on the 2nd Amendment which reinforces every American's right to bear arms, this show is a fly on the wall at "The Shootist" gun store in Englewood, Colorado, where salesman Josh Ryan is always in full-on pitch mode - and the steady stream of customers never stops. And for every gun sold by this expert gunslinger at this family-owned store, there's a fascinating story and a fascinating buyer to tell it to him: the new parent who wants to protect his family; the teenager who's an expert hunter; the 30-something woman who feels a little more at ease with a revolver in her purse and the avid collector who simply has a fascination with guns of all kinds. There's even a shooting range in the basement to try out the merchandise before completing the sale.

title: Rise 'n Shine Og
description: A show about an adorably hateful British woman living in Canada, trying to make her way through the world one miserable morning at a time. Rise 'n Shine Og is a comedic web series that chronicles the life of a lovable but crude 20 something slacker Brit living in Canada. Each webisode begins with our leading lady, Og, rising out of bed to meet the day. As is the case with all of us, some of Og's days start out on the right foot and some (most) do not, but regardless of how it begins she always manages to give the day an interesting spin... or does the day manage to give her a spin? Hmmm.

description: คุณหนูตาบอดหลินจืออี้กับหัวหน้าสายลับหลี่เจิ้งฮ่าว แต่งงานกันสายฟ้าแลบเพราะถูกครอบครัวเร่งเร้า คืนแรกที่จดทะเบียนสมรส หลินจืออี้ก็เผชิญหน้ากับคดีฆาตกรรมจนเกือบถูกฆ่าปิดปาก โชคดีที่ผู้รอดชีวิตอย่างเธอ สามารถแย่งชิงมรดกกลับมาจากพี่ชายต่างบิดาได้ โดยมีคนรักอย่างหลี่เจิ้งฮ่าวคอยช่วยเหลือ แต่ทว่า เนื่องจากอุบัติเหตุทางรถที่ถูกจัดฉาก ทำให้หลี่เจิ้งฮ่าวต้องตายเพราะปกป้องหลินจืออี้ และบริจาคกระจกตาให้เธอ ห้าปีต่อมา หลินจืออี้ที่กลับมามองเห็นได้อีกครั้ง กลับมาพร้อมลูกสาวเพื่อสอบสวนความจริงของอุบัติเหตุในตอนนั้น แต่กลับพบกับประธานหน้าหล่อแต่ใจร้ายอย่างหลี่เสวียนปิน การต่อสู้เพื่อฐานะและการต่อสู้ระหว่างตระกูลเศรษฐีจึงเริ่มขึ้น

title: Rock 'n' Road
description: Lin, who used to be a child star and is now a singer, meets Zhou, a music genius, dramatically changing not only life with his girlfriend Yang, but also his best friend Xu. title: 305fights / NMS / Art n Motion
description:
305fights / NMS / Art n Motion 

Tactics & Technical

Martial Arts exists on two primary planes:

Standing — Vertical Plane
Ground — Horizontal Plane

The objective remains the same:

1. Transition

* From a disadvantageous position
* To an advantageous position

2. Position

* Establish leverage and balance
* Create unbalance in your opponent

3. Delivery System

* Leverage creates efficiency
* Efficiency creates control
* Control creates opportunity

Success in combat is not determined by strength alone, but by the ability to improve position, control balance, and apply leverage at the right moment.

Special Thanks 🙏

Sensei Leo Barocas
Art N Motion Jiu Jitsu

title: O Som e o Tempo
description: A series of independent fictional episodes that follow the evolution of Brazilian popular music across the 20th century.

title: O Jogo
description: Auntie Nini dies, she leaves a big fortune, but to win it they'll have to play a game she left them, the relative who wins the game will own her fortune.

title: O Amuleto
description: Moçambique beach in Florianópolis, have a lot of unsolved murders cases. One day, Diana, Alex, Paulinho and Marcinha went to a party in the forest. In the next day, three teenagers are found death. Diana is the only survivor, but she doesn't remember what happen. The only thing that will help to solve the case is the videos recorded with their cell phones.

title: O Sol - Caminhando Contra o Vento
description: Documentary telling the story of short-lived newspaper "O Sol", an alternative press item which hit the streets during the repressive years of military dictatorship in Brazil, more precisely in 1968. Created by poet Reynaldo Jardim, it had important collaborators in Brazilian cultural scene.

title: O Trigo e o Joio
description: A sad and strong people living in the huge plains of Alentejo. Their endless struggle for bread, their nostalgic, bewitching songs and their daily toil to turn a dry, barren land into golden wheat fields.

title: O theios mou, o ninza
description: O theios mou, o ninza

title: O Mágico e o Delegado
description: Powerful magician goes to jail for creating illusion of affluence in Brazilian town.

title: O loustrakos
description: A small loustrakos manages with perseverance and the help of a lawyer to acquit his mother, unjustly accused of the death of her boss .

title: O prigipas
description: A farmer decides to stage his death in order to avoid paying his unfair debts and scare some people into doing the right thing. When he is seen alive by his fellow villagers they think it is a miracle which the military government of the time tries to take advantage of.

title: O Juízo
description: A man facing several crisis in his life after losing his job and dealing with alcoholism decides to move to a farm, owned by his grandfather. Followed by his wife and child, the turmoil in his life increases in strange ways when the phantoms of two slaves comes to haunt the place seeking revenge on the man's forefathers.

title: O' Schwarzwald, O' Heimat
description: After a burn-out Karl spends time in his home region, the Black Forest. His car gets lost and is picked up by penniless magician Amadori who enjoys posing as wealthy entrepreneur Karl while Karl reunites with the love of his youth, Liesl.

title: O Pistoleiro
description: The film tells the story of three hired killers: one of them is a veteran of the profession; the other is naive, almost mentally weak; and the third is a circumstantial murderer who commits murder for revenge and is forced by a principal to take the path of crime.

title: Selling the OC S1-S4
description: Jason Oppenheim, owner of the Oppenheim Group, expands the company opening a second office in Newport Beach.

title: O Predileto
description: Based on the novel "Totônio Pacheco", written by João Alphonsus. At the time of the decadence of the great farms of Minas Gerais, Totônio is a symbol of the golden age of state farms: old and accustomed to having all his wills obeyed. However, after moving to his son's home because of his wife's death and the resulting loneliness, he realizes that he has lost his job as a boss and is struggling to regain his prestige by moving to a brothel.

title: Deen-O
description: When a few local kids discover a dormant military operation, magic comes alive and the adventure unfolds as they learn about and defend their new friend Deen-O

title: O Bobo
description: Set four years after the Portuguese revolution and the simultaneous loss of the Portuguese empire in Africa, the story concerns a director who sells guns to finance his play.

title: O, schastlivchik!
description: Recently, Slavik has started to question the meaning of life and he has not found a positive or satisfactory answer. On the brink of suicide and about to end it all, Slavik is offered a chance to alter the outcome of his life.

title: Quando o Tempo Sela o Amor
description: Um acordo desenrola a perseguição persistente de Kim Woo-jin por Lim Eun-ju. Dizem por aí que ele a ama até os ossos. Acontece que Eun-ju vivia à deriva após o término com seu antigo amor e aceitou o pedido de Woo-jin por impulso. Woo-jin abandona o sonho de ser médico e vira marido em casa, dedicando-se em segredo a desenvolver um medicamento para a alergia dela. Mas ela continua fria, só com Seo Min-ho no coração. Quando Seo Min-ho retorna, Woo-jin pede o divórcio.

title: O Debate
description: A chief editor of a newsroom and a TV host, who were married for a long time, must try to conciliate their personal distinct views while working together during the coverage of a political debate of great importance for the nation's future.

title: O filos mou o Lefterakis
description: Thodorakis is a womanizer who lies to his wife about having a friend who lives in Patra in order to cover his dirty business. What happens when this fake friend appears in front of him and the night before he is ready to go with his mistress?

title: Harry O
description: After being shot in the line of duty, Harry Orwell was forced to retire from the San Diego Police Department. To supplement his police pension, Harry runs a private detective agency out of his beach house.

title: O Assalto
description: Lucas is in trouble, he has only a week to pay he's debts to Gomez. So he comes up with a plan and forms a team to steal a necklace that contains potential clues to a hidden treasure.

title: Nazm-o Nasr, Qowl-o Qazal
description: This concert was performed in September 2011 in Niavaran Cultural Center.

title: O Gado Deu o Troco
description: Leonardo fez de Marcela a rainha de Wall Street, mas foi empurrado de um telhado por ela e Breno no dia do próprio casamento. Ao abrir os olhos novamente, Leonardo se vê de volta à época da faculdade. Tendo essa nova chance, ele jura viver apenas para si, chega de ser o gado da Marcela. Ele até encontra alguém novo: a jovem herdeira da Família Holanda...

title: O Gorila
description: Afrânio is a retired voice actor. Lonely and tormented by memories of his childhood. In her small apartment, looking for a way to re-integrate into society.

title: O Rebelde e o Estudioso
description: Maya Hayes é uma aluna nota dez com um objetivo: estudar muito, escapar do pai violento e nunca mais olhar para trás. Mas ao buscar refúgio em um estúdio de tatuagem após uma surra, ela esbarra no rebelde do Colégio Oakridge, Jude Sinclair. Logo, a aluna exemplar e o garoto rico com um passado sombrio viram colegas de classe. As madrugadas viram segredos compartilhados, e os insultos dão lugar à compreensão. Aos poucos, enxergam além de suas armaduras e descobrem algo verdadeiro. Juntos, fazem um pacto: libertar-se, lutar e destruir tudo o que tenta derrubá-los.

title: Vice ibinahagi ang pangarap para sa relasyon nila ni Ion
description:
Oooh lala-van na lavan ang pitik ng bewang nina Baby Dolls Arianne, Chloe, Johaira, Juby, Jelai, Eriel, and Ina. To welcome their era as an official P-Pop group at kauna-unahang Hype Group ng bayan, ginanap ang Baby Dolls Day.

Present ang mga social media personalities, Kapamilya at Kapuso "PBB" ex-housemates, beauty queens, P-Pop groups, "Tawag Ng Tanghalan" alumni, "Showtime Online U" hosts, at All-Star Games Basketball at Volleyball Team para makigiling.

Pagkatapos ng Baby Dolls Day celebration, bumida naman ang beki na may talak para sa buong nation. Meet CY ng Quezon City, Fema Braganza ng Pangasinan, at BRIGIT ng Laguna, ang mga talakera na sumubok masungkit ang korona sa Miss Q and A.

Minsan ang talak, may pagka-harsh, parang comment ni Ogie Alcasid, na hindi inurungan sa puksaan si Vhong Navarro. Kaya ang ilong ni Vhong, napuruhan sa laitan!

Naloka naman ang Madlang People sa sagot ng mga kandidata sa unang tanong sa Tumpak Ganern tungkol sa karakter sa Noli Me Tangere na sinasabing ama ni Maria Clara. Ang sagot ni BRIGIT, "Nutridamus!" Kaya biro ni Vice Ganda, kapatid ba 'yan ni Nutri Bun?

Sina Fema at CY ang umabante sa next round ng chukchakan, ang Wit Lang. Pagkatapos ng talakan, ang very 'pulchritudinous', sabi ni Brent Manalo, na si CY ang kinoronahan bilang Miss Q and A Reyna Talak-Era of the day.

Pumadyak ang swerte at good vibes para sa mga pedicab driver na sumalang sa Laro Laro Pick game arena.

Nakaka-touch ang pagiging solid Showtimer ni Tatay Doms, na may iniabot pang liham ng pasasalamat para kay Vice Ganda at sa buong "It's Showtime" family. Pero, si Kim Chiu, nagtampo, dahil wala ang pangalan niya sa sulat na ito.

Pagkatapos ng aktingan, iisa lang ang naka-survive sa laro! Ito ay si Mavin, na kahit mahirap man ang buhay ay nananatiling masayahin. Kapang P300k ang napasakanya, babawi siya sa magulang niya. Pero sapat nang pambawi ang P40,000 na Li-Pot offer kaya dito na siya sa siguradong uuwi siyang panalo.

#ShowtimeBabyDollsDay
#ItsShowtimeFullEpisode 
#ABSCBNEntertainment

title: Jhong, Vhong at Kim, nagpagalingan ng joke
description:
Kung may isang alamat na hindi nakakasawang balik-balikan, ito 'yung alamat na masarap panoorin habang sila'y kumakanta at nagsasayawan. None other than P-Pop group, ALAMAT, na nagbabalik ang grupo sa 'It's Showtime' studio para i-perform ang Luzviminda,

Walang basaan dito pero bubumuhos ang swerte at good vibes kasama ang mga taga-San Juan City (na kilala sa 'Wattah Wattah' Festival) sa 'Laro Laro Pick' game arena.

Naglaro rin sina Teddy Corpuz, Darren Espanto, Jackie Gonzaga at Ryan Bang. Si Jackie lang ang nakatawid sa 'You Gotta Lyric,' kung saan tama naman ang sagot niya, pero pabirong idineklarang "wrong" ni Jhong Hilario dahil sintunado. To the rescue naman si Darren para itama ang tono! Dackie moment na ‘to!

Samantala, na-touch ang Showtime hosts sa kuwento ng buhay ni Wo, isang delivery rider na laki sa lolo. Habang itinataguyod ang sariling pamilya, gusto rin niyang maibalik ang sakripisyo ng lolong nagpalaki sa kanya. Samantala, 'extra' ang banter nina Kim Chiu at Jhong na nauwi pa nga sa dilatan ng mga mata. At syempre, kanya-kanya silang entry ng jokes tungkol sa pangalan ni Wo!

Very good din si Tate, ang tricycle driver na sweet lover kay misis, at may malasakit din sa kapwa. Minsan na niyang pinatunayan ang kabutihan nang ibalik ang gamit na naiwan ng pasahero. Kaya ang madlang girls sa studio, na-in love kay Tate! 'Yun nga lang, si misis, umapela, "Sorry po, married na!"

Luck ay na-attract ni Margo, ang hairstylist na 'di nauubusan ng kuwento. Pati tungkol kina Ogie Alcasid at Anne Curtis, meron siyang 'chismis.' At shoutout sa mga ex niya, hanggang tingin na lang daw kayo sa kan'yang ganda! Umabot sa P35,000 ang Li-Pot offer, na tinanggap ni Margo. Tama ang pinili ate n'yo dahil nang subukan niya ang P350k Pot question, akala niya'y 'simple' lang pero hindi pala niya alam ang kasagutan.

It's time for Region 1 to shine sa second week ng ika-10 taon ng "Tawag Ng Tanghalan."

Ang unang kalahok ay mula Laoag City, si Jeanel Silvestre, na nagpamalas ng husay sa entablado, singing Juan Karlos ‘JK’ Labajo's "Demonyo." Katulad ng idol na si JK, nagsusulat din ng kanta si Jeanel, na bet 'piratahin' ni Ogie nang magustuhan ang sample ng self-composition nito. Speaking of songwriting, may tip si Ogie tungkol d'yan.

Ang awit daw ay hinuhugot sa sariling kuwento, parang si Louie Ocampo, na binuo ang "Tell Me" mula sa sariling karanasan. Binalikan din ng 'Showtime' family ang iba pang iconic songs na nilikha ng maestro. Proud din si Ogie dahil komposisyon ng kanyang kaibigan

ang napiling bagong theme song ng isang airline. Chika niya, isa siya sa napakaraming tinalo ni Sir Louie sa paggawa ng theme song na 'to.

Samantala, napabilib ni Jeanel sina hurado Jonathan Manalo, Bituin Escalante, at Maestro Louie. Para sa kanila, strength ni Jeanel ang pagiging chill nito, at ang magandang tone.

Mula Pangasinan, lumuwas si Shekinah Barbiran to chase her dream sa tanghalan. "Ikaw Ay Ako" ni Klarisse De Guzman ang napili niyang sandata sa laban ng bosesan. At 15, 'beterano' na siya sa pagsali ng contests. Dahil seasoned kontesera, nakita ng hurados ang pagiging relaxed niya.

Nagustuhan ng hurados ang dalawang nagtanghal pero isa lang ang aabante sa susunod na round, at ito ay si Jeanel na nakakuha ng markang 91% laban sa 89.3% ni Shekinah.

title: Miss Q&A: Lucia, pagod nang magpanggap sa male pageants?
description:
Big pasabog ang naging announcement ni Bianca Gonzalez sa August 14 episode ng "It's Showtime." Kasama ang "Pinoy Big Brother" co-hosts na sina Gabbi Garcia at Kim Chiu, ibinalita ni Bianca ang muling pagbubukas ng Bahay ni Kuya sa pinakabagong "PBB Collab 3.0." 

To mark this new and exciting "PBB" era, nakisaya ang ilan sa mga ex-housemates. From Bahay Ni Kuya to the "It's Showtime" stage, muling nagsama-sama sa isang song and dance prod number sina “PBB Collab” ex-housemates AC Bonifacio, Klarisse De Guzman, Will Ashley, at Mika Salamanca, with Kabataang Pinoy Lella Ford, Joaquin Arce, Marco Masa, at Ashley Sarmiento na mula naman sa "PBB Collab 2.0."

Sa queendom ng talakan, isa lang ang pwedeng umangat. Pero sa araw na 'to, tatlong reyna ang nagharap-harap. Ibinuhos nina Sta. Lucia Joaquin Bordado, Miukie, at CK Alcaraz Zarfl ang wit at talak na di paaawat para korona ay sa kanila tumapat. 

Nakaka-reyna rin ang mga kuwento at inspirasyon na ibinahagi nila. Si Candidate 1, stop na sa pagpapanggap, kay from male pageants, Miss Q&A naman ang sinubukan upang maipakita ang totoong sarili. 

School teacher at dating principal naman si Candidate 2. Pero ano nga ba ang mga diskriminasyon na hinarap niya sa karera? At si Candidate 3, naghahanap ng kalinga ng ama. Nanawagan siya sa amang German, hoping na magkita sila soon sa unang pagkakataon.
Sina Miukie at CK ang nag-face off sa Wit Lang round. First time naman ni Bianca Gonzalez na umupo bilang hurado. 

Ang mga muscles nila ay kaflex-flex! Mag-work out din kaya ang swerte para sa mga gym instructors ng Metro Manila.

Si player Nad ang patunay na palaging may second chance ang taong determinadong mapaganda ang buhay. Ang dating number one sa inuman, gym na ang paboritong tambayan. 

Katulad sa real life, nabigyan din si Nad ng second chance sa laro. Matapos ma-eliminate ang lahat ngg players, bumunot ng isang sasalang sa jackpot round, at pangalan ni Nad ang nabunot.

#ABSCBNEntertainment

title: Q smette di ricordare
description: A woman named Q (Annalisa Lorihas) been seduced by the substance- the tobacco product that allows people to engage in a life that they didn't know what was possible. An almost alternate reality. Except Q finds out that this isn't just a sensation brought on by have the substance in her system, it is a reality. As she attempts to regain her past and former self, Q is manipulated and tortured by the agents of the substance. Now she must decide: give herself to the substance or try and find her real self.

title: Q an A
description: Join Robert Peterpaul as he sits down with acclaimed actors to gain valuable insight.

title: Q
description: This movie portrays evil against children. Innocent children. If this actually happens in real life the devil is alive and well.

title: Dear Mister Moon
description: When two stepsisters - 13-year-old Sigrid and 7-year-old Saara - meet each other for the first time, it will turn out that their grandmother has been taken to a retirement home. The girls make up their minds to steal grandma from the home and hide her in an attic-room where they could be all together. Everything goes unexpectedly well until drunkards, hoodlums and blackmailers interfere and the girls have to know exactly what they are doing in order to escape the gang.

title: Visitor Q
description: A troubled and perverted family find their lives intruded by a mysterious stranger who seems to help find a balance in their disturbing natures.

title: Detective School Q
description: A young and enthusiastic student anticipates joining the countries most proven detective school where he finds incredibly talented friends and various mysteries lurking ahead.

title: Miss Q&A candidate, may kakaibang dictionary!
description:
Mula sa iconic na “Jumbo Hotdog” at “Sana Mama” na minsang nagpaindak sa buong nation, nagbabalik to flex their muscles and new single ang grupong Masculados. Grateful ang grupo na makabalik at mabigyan ng pagkakataong ipagpatuloy ang kanilang musika.

Hindi lang ganda ang puhunan, dapat may wit na panlaban. Dahil bawat tanong, kailangang may sagot na papalakpakan ng buong bayan. Kaya naghanda ng matitinding linyahan ang mga Miss Q and A candidates na nagharapan.

Ready magbigay ng tutorial sa ganda at talino ang online tutor na si Precious Alden Ganaden, habang mula pageant coaching ay siya naman ngayon ang sasabak sa sariling laban, si MJ Apin Salada. Naaliw naman ang Madlang People, pati na si Vice Ganda, sa kakaibang dictionary ni Ivanach.

Sa second round na Wit Lang, sina MJ at Ivanach ang nagharap. Sinubok si Ivanach sa tanong na, “Kung lechon ka, mao-offend ka ba kung balat lang ang habol sa ’yo samantalang full package ka naman?” Si MJ naman, napaisip kunngmagtatampo ba ang king cobra kung hindi siya ang king of the jungle.

Ayusin ang display at siguraduhing kumpleto ang stocks at siguruhing available ang swerte. Mula sa pag-aasikaso ng mga produktong mabenta, saglit munang iniwan ng mga merchandisers mula NCR ang kanilang puwesto para subukang i-checkout ang POT money sa “Laro Laro Pick."

Kinilala ng hosts si player Frank, ang loving hubby and addy na baon sa utang. Kaya naman si Tyang Amy Perez, to the rescue bitbit ang payo niyang wais. Love life naman ang usapan nang kanilang lapitan si pplayer Yong, na dinamayan ng hosts matapos malamang hiwalay na sila ng kanyang girlfriend.

Kay Frank talaga napunta ang swerte dahil siya ang umabot sa Jackpot Round! Pero imbes na isugal ang lahat para sa ₱450,000 POT, pinili niyang tanggapin ang ₱35,000 Li-Pot offer para may siguradong maipambayad sa kanyang maraming utang.

title: Magdalena, kinaaliwan sa Miss Q&A
description:
What doesn't kill you makes you stronger, at sa bawat pagsubok ay mas tumatatag ang character. Mula sa Bahay ni Kuya, balik-“Showtime” na si Cianne Dominguez, hawak muli ang mikropono, slay kung slay sa pagpe-perform sa entablado. Group hug para kay Cianne!

Kung ang mood mo ay hindi kagandahan, mga beki ay may hatid kaming bonggang katatawanan. Sa talas ng isip at husay sa talakan, ang Miss Q&A candidates na ang bahalang magpagaan ng 'yong pakiramdam.

Sina Magdalena Fox, Maria Divina Bulawan Gil, at Yems Deligario Espinola, nagpalitan ng mga hirit. Si Magdalena, kinaaliwan sa kanyang pagpapakatotoo at transformation, at sa aktingan niya with Vhong Navarro.

Huwag hayaang malunod sa kalungkutan, sumabay sa alon ng saya at tawanan. Mula sa Dagat-Dagatan, Navotas, ang Madlang Players ay nakipagsapalaran, at baka sa Laro Laro Pick ay makabingwit pa ng malaking papremyo at kasiyahan.

Sa Act-Song round, ang script nila ni Darren Espanto, hindi kinaya ni Jackie Gonzaga sa kanilang aktingan. From one role to another, si Darren 'social distancing' pa rin ang gusto. Ayaw "madamay" kay hindi na lang daw muna siya magmo-move closer kay Cianne.

Sa jackpot round, si Aichelle ang sumabak sa larong may halong kaba. Ang Li-Pot offer na P25,000, tinanggap niya para siguradong may maihahanda sa darating na Pasko para sa pamilya. May panghihinayang nga lang na naramdaman si Aichelle dahil alam pala niya ang sagot sa P150,000 na POT question.

title: SexBomb Jopay, sumali sa Miss Q&A?!
description:
Napahugot ang madlang people sa pagbisita ng bandang Mayonnaise at sa kanilang performance ng “Bakit, Pt. 2.” 'Nag-spread' din sila ng good vibes nang makisabay sa trending “Meme” dance challenge!

Ang kandidata na mabagal sa pindutan at waley sa talakan, siya naman ang uuwing luhaan. Buti na lang palaban at ginalingan nina "Miss Q and A" JC Ibale, Anxji Rose, at Bon Joey Trinidad.

Habang kinikilala ng hosts ang tatlong ladies, pagandahan din sila ng mga joke entries. Ang starting lineup ay sina Vice Ganda, Jhong Hilario, at Vhong Navarro, pero 'di nagtagal, si Vhong ang unang napatalsik dahil sa joke niyang not-so matinik. First substitution of the day!

Chance na rin ito ng ibang hosts na sumabak sa "Miss Q and A." Maya-maya pa, nasubok naman ang husay ni Teddy Corpuz. Pero hindi pa man nagsisimula ang banter, parang may "issue" detected agad. Biro ni Meme, huwag gumigilid-glid si Teddy dahil baka magreklamo ito sa blocking, tapos ang netizens umariba na naman sa bashing.

Back to the pageant, unang pumaslak sa next round si JC, habang sina Anxji at Bon Joey ay nagbangayan tungkol sa "eulogy." Kaloka, mga teh! Pero pagkatapos ng mahabang diskusyon, si Bon Joey ang umabante sa Wit Lang at tumalak sa harap ng buong nation.

Kapag swerte ang bumagsak, huwag manghihina. Baka jackpot ang naghihintay sa players mula Marikina! POT money kaya ay maiuuwi nila?

Mukhang may dalang swerte talaga kapag ikaw ang first interviewee, dahil madalas, sa jackpot round, sila rin ang umaabante. Araw talaga ito ni Emon dahil siya ang naglaro sa POT o Li-POT round.

title: Miss Q&A Jomaima, bumoses tungkol sa edukasyon sa Pinas
description:
Sabi nila, may darating na someone, someday, 'yung kapag nakita mo siya parang laging may background music ang paligid. Kapit lang, dahil minsan dumarating 'yan nang biglaan. Habang hinihintay ang pagdating ng pag-ibig, heto na si Mr. Randomantic James Reid, handang magpakilig!

Lahat sa mundo may halaga, mula sa mga kulisap hanggang bulaklak sa hardin at mga puno (please huwag naman natin silang putulin). Sa Miss Q and A, boses ng mga kandidata ay may halaga at aral na puwedeng pulutin.

Huwag 'inaancha' ang mga kandidata dahil hindi sila basta-basta. May maipagmamalaking talento, talino at puso sina Summer Rejane Corpuz, Wilson The Buss, at Jomaima Johnson na nagpagalingan sa talakan.

Hot na hot talaga ang puksaan with special guest hurado Marina Summers. Present pa rin si Nicole Cordoves, with Ralph de Leon. Sina Wilson The Buss at Jomaima ang umabante sa Wit Lang. Parehobg bumoses, pero sa korona, isa lang ang sumakses! Si Jomaima ang wagi bilang Miss Q&A Reyna Talakers of the day.

Enjoy the feels, pero make sure na hindi mo mami-miss ang kulitan sa Laro Laro Pick kung saan bumida ang mga taga-Tonsuya, Malabon sa game arena.

Pagdating ng You Gotta Lyric round, si Dalag ang only player na naka-survive! Baka pampaalis ng kaba, nakipa-playtime si Dalag sa mga trip ni Vice Ganda hanggang sa Li-Pot offer na P35,000 ay kanyang tinanggap.

title: NAHILO! Pokwang, NILARO ang comment sa Miss Q&A
description:
Kilig harana ang hatid ng bisitang si John Rex Baculfo, who shared that it feels nice to be back onstage singing his new single, na tungkol sa mga taong patuloy na umaasa. Napahugot si John Rex doon ah!

Sa tanungan at talakan, bawal ang sabaw at lutang. Dapat mabilis mag-isip at mas okay rin 'yung chukchak na may halong tapang. Tatlong reyna muli ang sumabak sa "Miss Q and " daily round sa "It's Showtime."

Maraming baon sina Lianne Marie Etorma, Jerica Arboleda Ibarra, at Reign Manzano Gaboy pagdating sa kalokohan, syempre pati na rin sa talakan. Si Lianne nga ba ang totoong panganay ni Ogie Alcasid? "Kalokalike" ang hatol ng mga nagmamasid.

Si Jerica naman, pitong taon lamang nang magsimulang sumabak sa pageants. Kahit madalas talo, bakit hindi siya nagasasawang sumali sa mga patimpalak na ganito? At matapos malotlot ni Lianne, si Ogie nagbigay ng words of wisdom.

Sa "Wit Lang" round, nabunot ni Reign ang tanong na, “Sino ang anak ng mag-asawang sampal?” Laro rin ang tanong na napili ni Jerica, “Sa iyong palagay, mabaho ba ang hininga ng kaututang dila?”

Mapapaisip ka talaga sabay matatawa katulad ng na-feel nina hurado Pokwang, River Joseph, at Nicole Cordoves. Si 'Mamang' Pokwang, nilaro rin ang comment. Nahilo raw siya sa sagot ng isang kandidata, na sa sobrang lalim parang pwede nang hukayin.

Mga taga-Dela Paz, Antipolo, Rizal ang sumabak sa Laro Laro Pick game arena. Parang rollercoaster ang kuwentuhan ng hosts kay player Lizel, na naging 'judge' pa sa isang impromptu papogian portion ng male hosts. Sino nga ba ang pinakagwapo? Nanguna sa ranking si Vhong Navarro, at si Ogie Alcasid naman ang inilagay sa dulo, kaya siya ang naging target ng panunukso.

Umabante sa jackpot round si player Monique, isang volunteer tanod sa kanilang barangay. Para siguradong may maiuuwi, dedma na si Monique sa P400,000 POT question at tinanggap ang P30,000 offer na malaking tulong na raw para sa needs ng pamilya.

title: River Joseph, hurado sa Miss Q and A!
description:
Good music ang hatid ng “Tawag Ng Tanghalan” male champions na sina JM Yosures, Reiven Umali, JM Dela Cerna, Christian Tibayan, at Yannie Paul Basical. Pinagsama-sama ng limang powerhouse singers ang kanilang winning voices sa isang performance na perfect pampagaan ng mood bago sumabak sa weekend.

Nagbabalik sa "It's Showtime" for a second chance sa Miss Q&A Resbakulawan sina Nadie Marie Fernandez, Miukie, at Belle Tinkerbell.

Tumatak si Nadie dahil sa tawa niyang kakaiba. Natandaan naman ni Vice Ganda ang unique na pangalang Miukie. But arguably the most remarkable of the three, si Belle, na binansagang 'Sofronia Vasquez' ni Meme. Siya 'yung kandidata na sa pagpindot ay nahuli pero sa talak ang daming sinasabi. Hirit niya, baka pinabalik siya dahil awa, pero itinanggi 'yan ni Vice Ganda. Sabi ni Meme, nabitin daw ang lahat sa talak noon ni Belle.

Pagkatapos ng Wit Lang, ang Top 2 na sina Nadie at Belle ang nag-face off sa Beklamation kung saan mayroon silang tatlumpung segundo para sagutin ang tanong tungkol sa epekto ng pagkawala ng taong minamahal. Naging emosyonal si Nadie na inalala ang nawalang pamangkin, at galing din sa puso ang chukchak ni Belle na nagpahayag naman ng pagmamahal sa ina.

Dumayo sa Laro Laro Pick game arena ang mga taga-Barangay Batis, San Juan City. Hindi pasyal ang sadya nila kundi mga challenges na pwedeng magdala sa kanila sa POT money.

Nakipagkuwentuhan ng hosts sa tricycle driver na si Viomar. Pero ang nagpakitang-gilas, walang iba kundi si Amy Perez, na daig pa ang tricycle driver sa kanyang knowledge. Ang mga pasikot-sikot na kalye sa Maynila, kabisado ni Tyang!

Si Edwin ang nakarating sa Jackpot Round. Bago pa man ihain ang Li-Pot offer, buo na ang loob niyang ilaban ang ₱400,000 POT question anuman ang ialok sa kanya.

title: EMOTIONAL INTELLIGENT, nangakong babalik sa Miss Q&A
description:
Mga pusong dati’y takot magpakatotoo, ngayon ay rumarampa nang taas-noo. Huwag nang matakot at mangamba, mga accla! Be proud at huwag magtago sa dilim! Slay, mga bading!

Ngayong Pride Month, officially nag-come-BEK na ang paboritong talakan segment ng Madlang People at sangkabadingan. Pinangunahan ni Vice Ganda ang pagbubukas ng pinakabagong season ng "Miss Q and A" sa isang makulay na production number with the proud gay members of the LGBT community at si Anne Patricia Lorenzo, ang may-ari ng korona sa previous season na "Miss Q and A: Kween of the Multibeks."

Ang unang batch ng contestants na sumalang sa talakan ay ang ex-campus journalist na si Miss Jawo, ang ‘lutang’ call center agent na si Princess Elizabeth, at Erin Rio na isang call center agent din. Sa Round 1, nag-unahan ang tatlong beki na sagutin ang tanong gamit ang dalawang phrases. Ang first two contestants to earn a point lang ang aabante sa next round. 'Ligwak' si Princess. Pero kahit nagkatotoo ang pabirong prediction ni Meme Vice na hindi ito mananalo, positibo pa rin ang pananaw ni Princess sa kanyang 'Talak ng Lotlot' farewell speech.

Sa Round 2, bumunot ang natitirang contestantsng tig-isang tanong. Mas pinusuan nina Karylle, Ralph de Leon, at Nicole Cordoves ang sagot ni Miss Jawo judges sa araw na 'to.

Best in kulitan ang mga taga-Bignay, Valenzuela! Good vibes ang bigay nila sa Laro laro Pick game arena. Hindi pwedeng trip-trip lang ang performance sa mga games! Dapat galingan para sa chance na makapaglaro sa jackpot round.

Si Edzel ang umabante sa final game. Pero bakit si Ogie Alcasid ang teary-eyed nang mapag-usapan ang asawang si Regine Velasquez? At tulad ni Ogie, iiyak din ba si Edzel sa kanyang mapipili?

title: MC at Lassy, 'NAGSABUNUTAN' sa Miss Q&A
description:
Sa "It's Showtime" entablado they're always getting fiercer and fiercer with their new single "Spider." Here comes DNA, ready to slay! Ang singing trio nina Tasha, Julia at Ezri, nagpasikat sa harap ng Madlang People.

Ang pag-ibig, wala 'yan sa edad o kasarian. Kapag tumibok ang puso, huwag nang itago. Ipagsigawan ang damdamin! Ang feelings, aminin! Parang mga Miss Q and A candidates na hindi nagpapigil sa self-expression at pagtalak para marinig ng buong nation.

Mega slay sa pagrampa at talakan na havey ang queens na sina Francyne Astronomia, Kiana Ortega, at Dha-Dha Aringo.

Si Francyne na softie girlie, idol si Overtime Diva, Miss Trina. As a student, hate na hate niya 'yung mga kagrupo na palaging late. Si candidate 3, Dha-Dha, ipinakilala ang kanyang girlfriend of 9 years na si RR.

Sina Dha-Dha at Kiana ang umabante sa Wit Lang kung saan nasubok ang kanilang talino at creativity sa mga tanong na mapaglaro't nakakalito. Mas nagustuhan nina hurados Max Collins, Michael Sager, at Nicole Cordoves ang talak ni Kiana, kaya siya ang kinoronahan bilang Miss Q and A Reyna Talak-Era of the day.

Humataw nang wagas at napasigaw nang malakas ang Madlang Players mula San Jose, Navotas. Sa Laro Laro Pick game arena, malakas din ba ang swerte nila?

Malakas talaga ang chemistry ng DaCkie! Madlang People ay kinilig sa eksena nina Darren Espanto at Jackie Gonzaga. May pananagutan na?! Si Sergio (Vhong Navarro), nami-miss si Memerimar (Vice Ganda). Sobrang longing naman 'yan! Ang ating leading man, naghanap ng bagong Memerimar—walang iba kundi si Ryan Bang!

Sina Enteng at Mayang, parehong naka-survive sa You Gotta Lyric. Pero sa 'Laro Laro Pick,' one point lang ang kinailangan ni Mayang para umabante sa jackpot round kung saan nagkaroon siya ng pagkakataon na manalo ng P150,000.

title: May Brent, Ralph at Michael! Miss Q&A candidates, WINNER sa kilig!
description:
Ngayong July 3 and every day, ang tawanan sa "It's Showtime ay free. Kasama ang mga kandidata ng Miss Q and A, ang good vibes ay times three!

Sina Agua ng Parañaque City, Raux Araneta ng Negros Occidental at Kyla ng Laguna, kanya-kanyang paandar sa pagpapakilala sa Madlang People. Pero ang pinakagusto nilang makilala, eh 'di ang mga crush nila! Parang Valentine's season sa buwan ng Hulyo, kilig ng ladies ay todo-todo dahil kina Michael Sager, Ralph de Leon, at Brent Manalo.

Pero hindi lang crush ang kayang nilang ipaglaban, dahil pati sa social issues ay hindi matitinag ang kanilang paninindigan. Syempre, namana nila ang tapang ni Vice Ganda, na hindi matatakot 'ipahiya' ang mga magnanakaw, lalo na 'yung mga sangkot sa flood control scam, kung sakaling makasabay niya ito sa daan. Pero kung guwardiyado ang magnanakaw, teka lang, ibang usapan na 'yan.

Mukhang na-inspire ang mga kandidata kina Michael, Ralph at Brent dahil sa unang round ay mabilis ang kanilang pagpindot at pagsagot. Sina Agua at Raux ang nanguna sa Tumpak Ganern at nag-face off sa Round 2 na Wit Lang.

Parehong magaling! Mga answers nila ay winning! Kaya naman 'it's a tie' ang resulta. Sa araw na 'to, mayroon tayong dalawang Miss Q&A Reyna TalakEra.

Sa pinakabagong inaabangan na 'teleserye' sa tanghalian, ang You Gotta Lyric portion ng Laro Laro Pick, pang-finale ang eksena nina Vice Ganda bilang MemeRimar at Vhong Navarro bilang Sergio.

From aktingan, back to hosting si Vice Ganda upang papiliin si Duday, ang lucky player from Mandaluyong, kung Pot o Li-Pot ba ang desisyon niya. Wala nang patumpik-tumpik pa, Li-Pot offer ay itinodo na! Kaya hindi na rin nagdalawang-isip si Duday, at tinanggap na ang Li-Pot.

Ngunit laking pagsisisi ni Duday dahil nang subukan ang POT question, tama sana ang sagot niya. Pero tulad ng ipinangako ni Vice Ganda, dinagdagan niya ng P5,000 ang papremyo ni Duday sa oras na makasagot ito nang tama.

title: Miss Q&A Havana
description:
Kasama natin for today's video ang bandang The Red Strings, na very inspired sa paggawa ng nakaka-good vibes na musika. Sa mga taong naghahanap ng organic encounter, at para sa lahat, ang kanta nilang "Nasa Ulap."

Matatapos na ang June, pero hindi ang wit at tawanan sa "Miss Q and A." Sina Kishan Garcia ng Makati, Rhain Bayonon ng Manila, at Havana Alawi ng Quezon City ang nagPAKsiklabn sa 'chukchakan' today.

Para kay Kishan, her tattoos are part of her charm at kagandahan. Eh, kung may bagay na tattoo kay Havana, ano kaya ito? May naisip na si Vice Ganda! Pwedeng kulayan daw ng blue si Havana tapos ‘avatar’ ang kalalabasan. 'Amats' nga ni Meme ang beki na may kakaibang 'hugis' ang tainga, at ang boses ay tunog galing ibang planeta. Biro ni Meme, parang nagtatawag ng alien si Havana.

With grace and substance ang talakan nina Kishan at Rhaine sa Wit Lang. Si Kishan, nabunot ang tanong na, "Ilang oras ang dapat itulog ng jowa mong napagod na sayo?" Sagot niya, hindi dapat makatulog sa kaiisip sa kan'ya ang ex-jowa.

Mga kwentong nakakatuwa at may hati na inspirasyon at pag-asa ang pasalubong ng mga taga-Malanday, Marikina sa Laro Laro Pick game arena. Nakakuwentuhan nina Vice Ganda, Kim Chiu at Amy Perez ang isang tricycle driver, na pakiramdam ay wala ng pag-asa ang mga pangarap niya. Kaya ang payo nila, maniwala! Sabi nga ni Kim, "The world is big and so are your dreams."

Big naman ang aktingan sa inaabangan na 'You Gotta Lyric' round. Si Teddy Corpuz, tiklop sa mga lalaking malaki ang katawan. Si Jackie Gonzaga, tiklop naman sa paalala ni Ion Perez na taken na siya.

It must be the curly hair na naghatid ng swerte kay Bert, na sinugalan ang P100,000 POT money. Ano nga ba ang halamang pinakamabilis tumubo ayon sa Guinness World Records?

title: Miss Q&A candidate, ipinakilala ang girlfriend of 9 years!
description:
Sa "It's Showtime" entablado they're always getting fiercer and fiercer with their new single "Spider." Here comes DNA, ready to slay! Ang singing trio nina Tasha, Julia at Ezri, nagpasikat sa harap ng Madlang People.

Ang pag-ibig, wala 'yan sa edad o kasarian. Kapag tumibok ang puso, huwag nang itago. Ipagsigawan ang damdamin! Ang feelings, aminin! Parang mga Miss Q and A candidates na hindi nagpapigil sa self-expression at pagtalak para marinig ng buong nation.

Mega slay sa pagrampa at talakan na havey ang queens na sina Francyne Astronomia, Kiana Ortega, at Dha-Dha Aringo.

Si Francyne na softie girlie, idol si Overtime Diva, Miss Trina. As a student, hate na hate niya 'yung mga kagrupo na palaging late. Si candidate 3, Dha-Dha, ipinakilala ang kanyang girlfriend of 9 years na si RR.

Sina Dha-Dha at Kiana ang umabante sa Wit Lang kung saan nasubok ang kanilang talino at creativity sa mga tanong na mapaglaro't nakakalito. Mas nagustuhan nina hurados Max Collins, Michael Sager, at Nicole Cordoves ang talak ni Kiana, kaya siya ang kinoronahan bilang Miss Q and A Reyna Talak-Era of the day.

Humataw nang wagas at napasigaw nang malakas ang Madlang Players mula San Jose, Navotas. Sa Laro Laro Pick game arena, malakas din ba ang swerte nila?

Malakas talaga ang chemistry ng DaCkie! Madlang People ay kinilig sa eksena nina Darren Espanto at Jackie Gonzaga. May pananagutan na?! Si Sergio (Vhong Navarro), nami-miss si Memerimar (Vice Ganda). Sobrang longing naman 'yan! Ang ating leading man, naghanap ng bagong Memerimar—walang iba kundi si Ryan Bang!

Sina Enteng at Mayang, parehong naka-survive sa You Gotta Lyric. Pero sa 'Laro Laro Pick,' one point lang ang kinailangan ni Mayang para umabante sa jackpot round kung saan nagkaroon siya ng pagkakataon na manalo ng P150,000.

title: Ahtisa, pinuri ang Miss Q&A segment
description:
Major throwback feels ang hatid ni New Zealand singer-songwriter na si Bic Runga sa “It’s Showtime” nang kantahin niya ang kanyang hit na “Sway," na bahagi na ng playlist ng maraming Pinoy, lalo na noong ’90s at early 2000s.

Huwag ubusin ang wit, dapat laging may reserba lalo na kung sa 'Miss Q and A' ka eeksena. Pak na pak na palakpakan ang sumalubong kina Mariposa Jem Lacsina, Affarah Deur, at Curevedilol Filipinas Galore as they walked the runway and left the crowd wanting more.

Dahil kakaiba mga pangalan ng mga kandidata, na-curious si Vice Ganda at inalam ang kuwento sa likod ng mga ito. Kung ang "It's Showtime" family naman ang papipiliin, ano ng gusto nilang maging 'beki' name? Back to the pageant, hindi tumalab ang full pack makeup ni Curevedilol sa pabilisan sa pagpindot at pagsagot. Siya ang unang umuwing lotlot. Sina Mariposa at Affarah naman ang nag-face off sa Wit Lang.

Mga bituin at diskarte ang kanilang gamay para sumakses sa buhay. Swerte ay maningning, kaya POT money ang goal sungkitin ng madlang players mula Tala, Caloocan na sumabak sa Laro Laro Pick.

Agaw-eksena ang galawan ni player Rian. Kung twerking lang naman kasi ang labanan, si Jackie Gonzaga ay wit niya uurungan. Na-shookt ang everybody, lalo na si Vice Ganda, sa wild moves ni Rian sa dance floor. Para bang makabagong bunot ang peg!

Kinaaliwan naman ni Meme Vice si Gara, isa labandera, dahil super natural lang ng cuteness at charisma nito. Pero naging emotional si Gara nang mapag-usapan ang kanyang asawa. Na-touch si Meme sa kuwento, kaya may pakimkim na agad itong abuinaldo bago pa man dumating ang Pasko.

Kay Gara nga kumapit ang swerte. Sa jackpot round, siya ang umabante! Nadoble pa ang kanyang aguinaldo dahil umuwi siyang may tatlumpung libong piso, matapos tanggapin ang Li-Pot offer.

title: The Ultimate Esper R
description: The plot featured R and the Camera Club going on a stamp tour throughout Japan, with the threat of their club being closed down unless they can collect all the stamps by 6:00 PM.

title: R BnB
description: A wealthy Manhattan couple celebrates their first year wedding anniversary at a secluded Airbnb, only to realize that they are being secretly video taped. But why?

title: DVD-R Hell
description: Brad Jones shows off his large collection of DVD bootlegs, which contain everything from self-help videos to notorious TV pilots to animated specials.

title: You're Beautiful
description: As a young girl named Cora struggles with her harsh home and school life, her life changes forever when just 2 words are said to her.

title: R: Raja, Ratu & Rahasia
description: Ratu (Aurora Ribero) joins a club called Komplotan Rahasia (Secret Order) in order to bring joy to herself because her parents are dead. Then there's Raja (Brandon Salim) who loves Ratu. But Raja has a secret.

title: You're Beautiful
description: To most people including her family, 11 year old Shola is very disorganized and seemingly uninterested in life. But only Shola truly understands the internal struggles she faces and the constant bullying at school that she has to deal with; until she meets the new girl and they share a common bond. A story about self acceptance, reaching out and friendship.

title: R-15 [English]
description: Takuto Akutagawa has a special ability for writing porn novels. He applies to Hirameki Gakuen a high school which only accepts people with "Unique" talent. Now he must chase his dream and direct his classmates to win an interclass competition. All while trying to create the prefect harem.

title: R U Invited?
description: Invited! Five friends get invites to a sex party. But, in order to get the details, each must submit revealing pictures for approval. As party time draws near, friendships are tested, personalities clash, sexual histories are laid bare.

title: You're Not Supposed to Be Here

title: Chyort s portfelem
description: The journalist of the regional newspaper "Raduga" Mikhail Makarov, a fearless author of accusatory fieletons, a principled fighter against slovenliness and mismanagement, sharply criticizes the editor-in-chief, who does not let his scandalous articles go to press or cut off his scandalous articles due to lack of facts. Once buying potatoes at the market, Makarov meets a young saleswoman who offers him to collect critical material on her collective farm for the next fieleton. Having gone on an editorial trip and convinced on the spot in all the facts about the rotting record crop of potatoes, the enthusiastic journalist prepares a devastating article. But, unexpectedly finding himself for a short time in the place of his boss, and faced with the real bureaucracy in the planned economy of various departments, Makarov changes his mind.

title: Brasil S/A
description: Brazilian Dream is fruit of reflection on Brazil today. We Brazilians are used to seeing the country as peripheral, subaltern, poor and third-world. But in recent years Brazil has experienced rampant transformation that has reconfigured its archaic social structure. Yet this difficult and paradoxical modernization runs up against problems that seem to be historically determined. In the film we ask: what images can capture this new country? And we chance a few answers, starting with the delirious fable-spinning of a nation drunk on its own progress. These are images and sounds that echo and, at the same time, collide with the grand founding narratives of the national mindset. Through these images we enter into conflict with the messianic vocation of a Brazil eternally pre-destined to be the country of the future. Bodies, machines and landscapes move and shudder. Until the final eclipse.

title: Resurrecting McGinn(s)
description: Declan, an author struggling with his unrealized potential, is confronted by renewed grief over his long dead brother Aidan. His wife Anastasie suggests they throw a party on what would've been Aidan's fiftieth birthday. Over the course of dinner, revelations of sexuality, race, abortion, love, life and death unroll at a feverish pace as the night escalates into mayhem.

title: The Occupant

title: Mittal V/S Mittal
description: Girls have dreams - dreams of a fairytale romance, of prince charming sweeping them off their feet, a dream wedding and living happily ever-after. Mitali, a successful model, also had dreams... Then one day she met Karan, the Mittal scion, the heir to one of the richest families in the country. Mitali 's simple, middle-class upbringing is in complete contrast to Karan's super-brat lifestyle. But Karan was smitten by Mitali. Accustomed to getting what he wants in life, Karan landed up at Mitali's home with his parents with a marriage proposal. Delighted at their daughter's luck, Mitali's family approved of the match. And Mitali entered Karan's home and life as his newly-wedded bride. It was not long before Mitali's dreams turned into her worst nightmare. Her mother-in-law detested her and created misunderstandings between Karan and her. Karan turned out to be a puppet in his mother's hands and her father-in-law is a helpless, mute spectator. Karan has a certain pattern of dealing with women and wanted to subdue Mitali's independent streak. He who appeared to be a loving husband was in fact a violent monster at night within the privacy of their bedroom.Unable to bear the humiliation and pain after she resisted his advances and is raped by him,Mitali decided to take charge of her life. She decided to fight back.Mitali walked out of her in-laws home, hired a lawyer and filed a case against her husband. Karan retaliated by hiring the best lawyer money can buy to fight on his behalf. Mittal Vs Mittal is about to he heard in court. It is a case on file that fights for the rights of women like Mitali who are subjugated to domestic violence and inhuman treatment at the hands of husband and in-laws. It is a case that will empower women to fight for their pride, respect and their very right to live with dignity. It is Mitali Mittal versus Karan Mittal...

title: Daily T
description:
Thomas J Elliott is a master filmmaker who has worked all over the world, creating multi award winning projects for some of the world's leading global brands, from Coca-Cola to Microsoft, Manulife, global advertising agencies and anywhere and everywhere in between.

Beyond his work in content and commercials, he has directed documentaries, television series and more recently he has branched off into feature films and streaming content.

He is the author of five award-winning, best-selling books on visual content and visual storytelling.

In addition to this he is a regular contributor to leading educational workshops and events all over the world, from massive events like VidCon to private workshops for universities, think tanks and global brands and agencies.

In this first of its kind series created exclusively for social media platform LinkedIn, Thomas shares his thoughts on crafting and creating films and visual content as well as a deep dive into the directing process that covers everything from selecting the right material, to working with actors and crew, on set process and getting your work completed and out there.

The series provides a unique insight into an established working director, his process, the reality of working with brands, agencies, production companies, actors and production partners.

It shows the audience real world examples they can use in their work immediately to improve the quality of their work and their output.

Episodes are released weekly Monday to Friday on LinkedIn and across other channels.

title: Cin(T)a
description: Cina and Annisa love God and God loves them both. But Cina and Annisa cannot love each other because they call God by different names

title: Clocking the T
description: Dave is a professional internet troll who lies for a living. Candace is in human resources at a blood lab with a bipolar boss. They meet online and circle the airport of their relationship, refusing to land.

title: Loyal-T
description: Loyal-T is a drama depicting the life of Travis Jones, and Malia Parker, best friends since childhood. The two faced different challenges in life, but their decisions brought them to the path of selling drugs.

title: Ginto't pilak
description: Dina and Ben are hustlers who enjoy extorting money from the rich and the famous. Their lives take an ugly turn when one of their victims turns out to be a member of a notorious Japanese gang.

title: Don't Speak
description: Can you keep a secret? I haven't heard anyone for a long time until they arrived. They came for help and they broke the rules. I tried to warn them but it was too late. Little did they know. The party is over. Who will survive?

title: Podvodnaya lodka T-9
description: The Great Patriotic War. The Soviet submarine T-9, having passed through the minefields of the North Sea, penetrates into the enemy port. Sailors sink enemy transport ships, but soon find out that they were late - enemy troops and weapons have already been unloaded and sent to the front. Captain Kostrov finds himself in a situation where the combat mission is almost impossible, but he must complete it - for him it is a matter of honor or dishonor.

title: Dr. T and the Women
description: A wealthy gynecologist's ideal life is thrown into turmoil when the women closest to him begin to affect his life in unexpecting ways.

title: T-Bird Gang
description: A high school boy, out to find his father's killer, joins up with a gang of juvenile delinquents.

title: Emp4t
description: A supernaturally sensitive girl is haunted by a mysterious entity linked to her dark past. As the entity begins attacking her friends, the situation grows increasingly dangerous.

title: Tank T-34
description: During World War II, a squad of Soviet POWs steals a tank from Nazi test site and rushes into a desperate shoot over Germany.

title: Sammy's Super T-Shirt
description: A young boy's lucky t-shirt is transformed through a power surge and gives its wearer super-powers.

title: T-Force
description: When T-Force robots face shutdown after a failed hostage crisis, they turn violent to survive. A police lieutenant and one loyal cybernaut must stop their deadly rampage.

title: Terrifying T-Rex
description: A towering T-Rex, thought to be extinct for 65 million years, is unleashed after an asteroid hits Earth. The president sends his secret weapon, a female secret agent named Bellatrix, to stop it's reign of terror.

title: Turn on to T-Bag
description: T.Bag has moved into the back of an old television set and intends to take over the airwaves with High-TV and put all the viewers under her spell. Professor 'Sparky' Sparkes and Children's TV presenter Holly-Anna Jones mean to stop her with a jamming device powered by nine crystals. But T.Bag takes hold of the crystals and hides them in various upcoming programmes. Now it is up to Holly to find them all before T.Bag starts her transmissions.

title: T-Junction
description: After the passing of her estranged father, Fatima makes an unlikely friend at a hospital, Maria. Bound by pain, Fatima keeps coming back to hear Maria's tale of the T-junction where she found love and loss in a ragtag community.

title: T-Bag Bounces Back
description: T. Bag has regained her powers and calls her former servant, Thomas, into a storybook and makes him serve her tea again as 'T.Shirt'. Debbie follows her friend and soon discovers she has to locate all the silver numbers from the town clock that T.Bag has hidden in the book's various chapters.

title: Que reste-t-il... ?
description: Tina and Claude live in a retirement home. They are in a new relationship with each other happy and openly affectionate. But they are the exception in an environment where the loneliness of the body and mind predominate. At the end our days, when we are left solitary, What remains...?

title: Making Sh*t Up
description:
This film takes you behind the scenes in the timeline of a dynamic and ambitious young conceptual artist, from his "Clearance Sale" of a lifetime's work at ArtLA, to weeks of dispensing therapy at the Whitney Biennial, to a near-death injury on Miami's Biscayne Boulevard and the mindset that followed. Includes detailed on-site action at art installations and performances, with spirited opinions from celebrated artists and art world professionals about measuring the success and value of conceptual art.

The film is narrated with spirited, candid commentary by important artists and art professionals such as legendary conceptual / performance artists Marina Abramovic and Vito Acconci on the highs and lows of a conceptual art world with uniquely difficult career choices, by famed New York Magazine Senior Art Critic Jerry Saltz on what is and isn't conceptual art and how Rodriguez measures up, author Steven Henry Madoff about Rodriguez service aesthetics achievements, and celebrated New York art blogger C-Monster.net, who experienced the artist, face- to-face and alone, locked inside his therapy cube.

title: T: Ghosts in the Machine
description: Two men meet and discover that they are both guided by invisible ghosts and they are in fact two machines forced to live a life haunted by Tinnitus.

title: I Won't Forget
description: After a tragic loss shatters her family, Mia battles grief and turmoil, forced to choose between escaping the past or succumbing to it.

title: T for Taj Mahal
description: A young man's journey to bring literacy to his village through a unique social enterprise.

title: Uppity: The Willy T. Ribbs Story
description: An in-depth profile of the life and career of Willy T. Ribbs - the controversial Black driver who shattered the color barrier of professional auto-racing and became the first Black qualifier in the storied history of the Indy 500.

title: Sparkle U
description: Each story of Sparkle U reflects the social media feeds of Filipino youth nowadays as well as their struggles and issues in life. A self-contained miniseries following different sets of characters and storylines, each narrative is related to the fictional universe called Sparkle University. Sparkle University is a conservative, parent-funded, all-inclusive university that offers educational programs from elementary, high school, senior high school, to undergraduate studies. Can the youth of today, who is greatly exposed to social media, survive the real world where people can't just mute or delete someone in their life? How can they solve their problems if their parents don't understand where they are coming from?

title: Luv U
description: Lessons in love through the eyes of six teen students of Lambertu Uy Villarama University (or LUV U) as they experience the highs and lows of being in love at a very young age.

title: Vamp U
description: After killing his love, Mary, vampire Wayne can't grow his teeth. To pass the time he becomes a professor. Everything changes when he turns Chris, a dead ringer for his long dead love and her taste for blood spins out of control.

title: Duh u mocvari
description: A brother and sister, Miron and Melita, go to visit their friend Zoltan (Liptus) in Kopacevo for winter vacation. The local residents and hunting lodge members there are involved in a big campaign to help the wild animals from the reserve to survive the winter. The same night Miron and Melita arrive, a boy named Halasz is found half-frozen at the edge of the swamp where, he raves, that he was attacked by a white ghost on one of the islands of the swamp. From then on, he can no longer talk. The old woman Etelka reveals the secret that the ghost had been first seen long ago and that you cannot go to the island because the ghost wreaks vengeance on anyone stepping onto the island. Fear takes hold in the place. The hunters, with Vucevic, Kovacevic and Levay taking the lead, begin an investigation however neither they nor the doctors can help Halasz. Therefore Miron, Liptus and Melita decide to find the ghost and offer to carry it off the island to the shore in exchange making their friend well again. However, the ghost shoots and wounds the hunter Levay proving that the ghost is much more dangerous than was previously thought.

title: Miss U
description: The three best friends Sanjh, Sakshyam and Jasmine probably developed their friendship in some foreign college they attended together. What will happen next is the curiosity that may arise in everyone's mind.

title: Run 2 U
description: A Japanese club singer finds himself in trouble with the yakuza. He flees to Korea, where he meets an alluring lounge singer.

title: Stoyne u kostenurka
description: Stoine has been called up and is on his way to the barracks accompanied by his father Rangel. Some tanks appear. Rangel watches them. He recalls the war in which he took part and regrets that no such "tortoises" were available at the time. Stoine explains that money is needed for purchase all of this. Rangel leaves Stoine in the hands of sergeant mayor and promises to buy a tank for his son. At home he takes a small money bag from a chest. In the bank a clerk counts the money for the rearmament of the country... The hatches of one tank open and Rangel and Stoine appear. The father begins to fire with a machine gun... But all this turns to be a dream - Rangel's wife funds him clutching the bedstead. Rangel tells her everything about the "tortoise". The two beam with satisfaction.

title: Chopped U
description: Chopped U pits two young food aficionados in direct culinary competition to battle it out in the kitchen. Contestants are given 30 minutes and four mystery ingredients to create a delicious and unique dish, to be judged by Lazarus Lynch.

title: Mee Aani U
description: At every corner there is a love story blooming. Most have usual problems but few are exceptional. Mee Ani U is one of them. Abhishek and Ira meet through Facebook (Social Networking).Initially it's a game of hide and seek with their fake facebook profiles. After a while it moves from internet to mobile, Chatting to Texting sharing each and every information with harmless flirting. With day-to-day sharing and caring, lovely Ira starts getting involved with the playful Abhishek.But this is not why our story is exceptional. Even though over internet they are in love but in person they hate each other. Will Abhishek change for his love? Will Abhishek and Ira realize their love for each other? And if they do how will they realize? A Fun, Twisted love story with a Fresh treatment. Youth oriented, full on dhamaal Masala is...''Mee Ani U''

title: Equality U
description: At nearly 200 colleges you can be kicked out for being gay. A group of 33 young activists set out on a cross-country tour to confront anti-gay policies at conservative colleges. They face a daily onslaught of abuse, harassment and arrest.

title: U oluji
description: Rose is a young woman who lost her husband in WW2, leaving her and their daughter behind. She gets close with his good-natured brother Drago. However, an unscrupulous smuggler Vincenzo is always around him, and the things get tough for the couple.

title: U-Turn
description: Scott, a smug Montreal lawyer, searches for the girl of his dreams whom he met briefly four summers previously, when she was in a sports car on a tiny ferry going to an island in the St. Lawrence. Meanwhile, his girlfriend Bonnie is pressuring him to marry her.

title: Zavtrak u predvoditelya
description: The leader of the nobility undertakes to settle the protracted dispute over the division of the inheritance between the brother and sister. As a result, all participants and witnesses quarreled among themselves.

title: Grendizer U [English]
description: Duke, crown prince of the dying planet of Fleed, starts a new life on Earth. When the evil Vega brings the battle to him, he decides to fight back using the mighty Grendizer.
